chapter_title: Concerning the Four Works of the Ambassador
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:** When
 Divine
 Truth proce
eding from the Lord first
 presented
 itself to the interior
 understanding
 in
 an accommodated form, four distinct spiritual
 operations were accomplished
,
 each sur
passing the
 other
 in excellence.


**¶2:** The first
 operation is
 the manifest
ation itself
 —
 that
 Divine Truth appeared
 before
 the understanding in a form of celestial
 rad
iance:
 the
 Lord
 made
 visible to
 the inner
 mind according
 to its
 capacity to
 receive.


**¶3:** The second
 is
 that
 all passages
 between
 the
 discrete
 degrees of the mind were
 opened at
 that time —
 the
 boundaries
 separ
ating the
 natural
,
 the
 spiritual, and the celestial were
 unse
aled so
 that infl
ux could
 desc
end un
impeded from
 in
most
 to out
most.
 They
 open to
 receive
 the
 Divine
 proce
eding,
 and close
 again behind
 it
,
 so
 that each
 degree remains
 distinct and protected once
 the
 communication
 has
 been established.

**¶4
:** The third is
 that
 wisdom
 was
 liberated and purified from
 the
 falsities
 in
 which
 it had been held
 capt
ive,
 and
 this
 liberation
 was accomplished through the very
 manifestation of Divine Truth. The
 wisdom so
 freed exce
eds even
 the illumin
ation that had
 existed
 before the
 capt
ivity —
 for
 truth
 tested
 against
 falsity and
 released
 becomes
 cle
arer than
 truth
 that has never
 been contested
.

**¶5:** The
 fourth:
 Through
 the regener
ation of human minds brought
 to
 completion,
 the Lord
 made
 manifest
 His
 containing
 form for
 Divine
 Wisdom —
 the
 vessel
 in
 which all
 rescued
 understanding
 is
 gathered
 and 
borne up
ward.
 The
 interior
 spiritual
 life, con
joined from
 good and truth together
, sh
one
 forth in whol
eness and full
ness even
 into
 and
 over those
 states
 of 
enmity ruled
 by self-love and falsity —
 not
 destroyed
 by
 them, but rad
iant
 against
 them.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the Ambassador displayed his image, four great works were revealed that are very excellent and outstanding.
The first is his image that he displayed in a glorious image.
The second is all the doors of the firmaments that were opened at that time. They open [before him] and shut behind him.
The fourth: He has [made apparent], by the perfection of people, his Light Ship. He has [gathered together] the Living Soul that shone forth in perfection and fullness over the worlds of enmity.

The third is the Light
 and the releasing that was purified by
 his image. That Light is more than
 the light that he shall [purify
 on every other day from the mixture]
